title: db_pool::open_any_pool calls process::exit in library
description: crates/core/src/db_pool.rs calls std::process::exit(1) when the pool fails to open. This is a library crate; process::exit in library code is hostile to callers — it makes the error unrecoverable, untestable, and uncatchable.\n\nFix: return Result<AnyPool, StorageError> (or equivalent) and let the binary crate decide how to handle a fatal pool error.
